tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Oat. The page and screen background everywhere.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, sheets, the tab bar and inputs, lifted off `surface` with `shadow-sm`.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Wells: the quick-log sheet's input area, progress tracks, the coach composer.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and resting input borders. Decorative only; never the sole edge of a control.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons, on `surface`, `surface-raised` and `surface-sunk` (12:1+ in both themes).

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, hints and metadata, on the three surfaces only (5:1+). Never on a pastel fill.

tokens.name: on-pastel
tokens.usage: Text and icons on any pastel fill (`apricot` … `rose`), 8:1+ in both themes. The primary button's label.

tokens.name: apricot
tokens.usage: Brand hue. Primary button fill, the sun in the mark, today's highlight. Text on it is `on-pastel`.

tokens.name: apricot-ink
tokens.usage: Apricot as text, links and icons, on the surfaces (5.3:1+). Not on an `apricot` fill.

tokens.name: sage
tokens.usage: Steady ground. Completed habits, the score ring's track, the Settle phase. Text on it is `on-pastel`.

tokens.name: sage-ink
tokens.usage: Success text, the score ring's progress arc and 'done' ticks, on the surfaces (6.3:1+).

tokens.name: lilac
tokens.usage: The coach's voice: coach bubbles, the Coach tab highlight, the Steady phase. Text on it is `on-pastel`.

tokens.name: lilac-ink
tokens.usage: Lilac as text and icons on the surfaces (6.5:1+); also the focus ring colour.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Information and hunger: the selected hunger rating, 'talk to your prescriber' notes, the Land phase. Text on it is `on-pastel`.

tokens.name: sky-ink
tokens.usage: Sky as text and icons on the surfaces (6.1:1+).

tokens.name: butter
tokens.usage: Gentle attention: the early-warning nudge card and the reset week. Never alarm red. Text on it is `on-pastel`.

tokens.name: butter-ink
tokens.usage: Butter as text and icons on the surfaces (5.8:1+).

tokens.name: rose
tokens.usage: Destructive confirmations only (delete account, delete all data). Text on it is `on-pastel`.

tokens.name: rose-ink
tokens.usage: Destructive text and form errors on the surfaces (6.3:1+).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus ring, an alias of `lilac-ink`: solid, 6.5:1+ on every surface.

groups.name: Display
groups.note: Fredoka (Google Fonts): round, soft, set at 500–600. Headlines and numbers only.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: Onboarding welcome, plan reveal, paywall headline. Once per screen.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Screen titles at the top of each tab.

styles.name: numeral
styles.usage: The landing score and big stats. Use tabular figures.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Nunito (Google Fonts): rounded terminals, comfortable at small sizes.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Your appetite may come back slowly. That's normal, and it's what this plan is for.
styles.usage: Weekly lessons and coach replies: anything read rather than scanned.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Add protein to breakfast on five days.
styles.usage: Default UI text: habit labels, list rows, form text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels, chip text, tab labels, button text at small size.

spacing.note: 4px base, generous by default: screens breathe.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inside chips; between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between rows in a list of habits.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding on phones; the screen's side gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Card padding for hero cards (score, plan reveal).

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between cards and sections.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a screen title; between onboarding blocks.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Onboarding top and bottom breathing room.

radius.note: Everything is rounded; nothing in the app has a sharp corner.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small inner elements: checkbox wells, chart bars, tooltips.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, list rows, coach bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets (quick log) and the paywall panel.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, toggles, the tab bar's active pill, round checkboxes.

shadow.note: Soft and warm, never grey. Darker and tighter in dark mode.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards and the tab bar at rest.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and anything floating.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: a 3px gap in the page colour, then a solid 2px `focus` ring. Follows the element's radius.
